Step 5

Google Business Profile post

Google Search your outlet name → Add update → upload the image → paste the text → add a button. Never type phone numbers, links or hashtags in the text: Google removes those posts.

Post text
Slipped back to your old kopitiam order? One slip is not a reset, just plan tomorrow's cup. In Episode 7 of our Uncle Lim family story, his son Jun walks home from a night shift and finds his father with the old sweet teh tarik. The house had become too quiet, and the old drink felt like the old mornings. At Alpro Pharmacy KSL City Mall, our pharmacist simply listens and asks one question: what is tomorrow's plan? A few ideas for getting back on track in Johor Bahru: Decide your drink on the walk there, not at the table Step down one rung: kurang manis, then kopi-O, then kosong Add two half-boiled eggs so breakfast feels complete Have breakfast with company when you can Want to talk it through? Walk in for a Minute Consult with our pharmacist, no appointment needed, or ask about Dietitian and Nutrition Counselling. If your doctor has given you a plan, that plan comes first. Ground Floor, Lot G-001, KSL City Mall, Taman Abad, Johor Bahru. Open daily from 10AM to 10PM.
